question: Should task suggestions be enabled for the Gateway-backed TUI by adding a first-class accept/dismiss action sink now, or should the tools be gated to Control UI until TUI support is designed?
rationale: The narrow bug is source-proven, but the durable fix crosses model tool availability, Gateway session/action semantics, and a new TUI operator workflow, and the item carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Implement explicit action-sink gating and TUI flow
options.body: Add a per-turn capability that exposes task-suggestion tools only to actionable operator surfaces, with TUI inspect, accept, and dismiss behavior wired to managed-worktree session creation.

options.title: Gate to Control UI for now
options.body: Keep the current Control UI behavior and suppress task-suggestion tools for TUI, channels, and non-operator clients until a portable action sink is designed.

options.title: Split product and bug work
options.body: Land a narrow gating fix first, then track TUI accept/dismiss as separate product work.

recommendation.title: Implement explicit action-sink gating and TUI flow
recommendation.body: Add a per-turn capability that exposes task-suggestion tools only to actionable operator surfaces, with TUI inspect, accept, and dismiss behavior wired to managed-worktree session creation.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and landed the related task-suggestion feature and is assigned to this protected issue.
